name: Autocomplete widget with mixed matching
description: Entity reference autocomplete widget that runs STARTS_WITH first, then fills the remaining slots with CONTAINS matches.
project_description: Provides an entity reference autocomplete field widget that combines STARTS_WITH and CONTAINS matching. It first returns entities whose label starts with the typed string; if fewer than the match limit are found, the remaining slots are filled with entities whose label merely contains the string. This puts the most relevant (prefix) matches at the top while still surfacing substring matches, which neither of core's single operators does on its own: STARTS_WITH can return nothing when every label begins with a prefix like "The" or a number, and CONTAINS can bury the exact match under less relevant results. Implemented as a field widget (MixedMatchingAutocompleteWidget, extending core's EntityReferenceAutocompleteWidget) that hard-codes the primary operator to STARTS_WITH and a fallback operator to CONTAINS, plus a decorator of core's entity.autocomplete_matcher service (AdvancedEntityAutocompleteMatcher) that understands the extra fallback_match_operator selection setting and performs the two-query fallback chain. Matching, sorting and access filtering are delegated to the core entity reference selection handler.
